layouts.name: St Ursanne
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The operator and municipal closure notice identify Route des Rangiers / road 249 from St-Ursanne through Grippons towards Les Rangiers. The selected independent road chain follows the main Grippons roundabout using its forward source-node order and the legal approach and exit lanes, excluding the residential bypass. Both catalogue timing positions agree with existing source endpoints. The road-centreline draft measures 5210.6 m; published race distance is 5180 m and the catalogue scalar is 5199 m. Race-day temporary barriers and exact historical alignment remain provisional. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 5210.6 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
